entities.title: Deployable
entities.summary: A thing that gets deployed as a unit: a service, a Worker, an app, a scheduled job, a library published as a package. Each carries its own Documentation/ directory under its root.
notToBeConfusedWith: Repository: where source is kept. Often the same thing as a deployable; in a monorepo, one repository holds several deployables.

entities.title: Repository
entities.summary: Where source is kept. In a monorepo, each deployable gets its own Documentation/ under its own root, and the repository's top level keeps only what is shared.
notToBeConfusedWith: Deployable: the thing deployed as a unit.

entities.title: Source of truth
entities.summary: A document that holds its subject itself, rather than pointing at where it is held. Each template's first line after the title says whether it is the source of truth or a pointer.

entities.title: Pointer file
entities.summary: A document whose subject is held elsewhere (a business plan in another document, an on-call rota in the paging tool). It links there and still says, in a paragraph, what the reader will find and why it matters to the deployable, so that the link going dead is noticed.
